step_by_step_extraction.step: Apply Theorem stokes with Omega=D(z_0,r), lambda=n/|z_0|
step_by_step_extraction.notes: Exact application of the universal Stokes-theorem identity. No hidden constants at this step; the X_i are the 5 explicit error integrals defined at lines 364-368 (X1-def through X5-def).

X_2 = integral over E_2 cap Omega cap {|psi| <= lambda} of |psi| dA, bounded by lambda * area(Omega) = (n/|z_0|) * pi r^2. Pulling the pi inside the Vinogradov gives K_X2 <= pi. Tight value pi ~ 3.14.

X_4 = integral of |lambda'|/|lambda| dA. Tao chose lambda = n/|z_0| constant in z, hence lambda' = 0 in the inner region of D(z_0, r). Mollification near origin contributes 0 since z_0 != 0 keeps D(z_0,r) away from origin (r < |z_0|/2).
X_5 is the arclength of the boundary of Omega = D(z_0, r). Exact: 2 pi r. K_X5 = 2 pi ~ 6.28.

step_by_step_extraction.candidate_value: X_1 <= K_pp * pi * n * r^2 <= K_pp * pi * n * r^2 / |z_0| * 2 (using r < |z_0|/2)
step_by_step_extraction.notes: X_1 = integral over E_2 cap Omega of |p'| dA. By pp-bound (line 1397): |p'(z)| << n on E_4. The absolute constant K_pp in '|p'| << n' is bounded by a Cauchy estimate plus the explicit constant from pp-factor (line 221), riesz-bound (line 739), and quam-0; small absolute number, K_pp <= 10 generously. Times area pi r^2 gives X_1 <= 10 pi n r^2 <= 20 pi n r^2 / |z_0| using r < |z_0|/2. Hence K_X1 <= 20 pi ~ 63.

step_by_step_extraction.candidate_value: X_3 <= K_X3 * (n r^2 / |z_0| + r + ||p||_1 log n / n) with K_X3 absorbing the Riesz 2 pi factor and the cosec-asym leading 1
step_by_step_extraction.notes: Tao decomposes X_3 into three pieces. Minor contribution near critical points: bounded by O(n * n * n^{-2} r) = O(r) using multip's 2 pi factor; gives <= 2 pi r ~ 6.28 r. Main contribution: '|z_0|/n times sum over zeta of integral of 1/|z-zeta|^2 dA over D(z_0,r)\D(zeta,n^{-2}r), each integral O(log n) with improvement r^2/|z_0|^2 for zeta in D(0,|z_0|/4).' By markov (line 242), at most ||p||_1/|z_0| critical points fail this improvement. Final: X_3 <= 2 pi (r + n r^2 / |z_0| + ||p||_1 log n / n). K_X3 <= 2 pi ~ 6.28.

Psi(E) = (1/pi) integral_E |psi| dA. Triangle inequality + psi-expand: |psi| <= sum_zeta 1/|z-zeta|. By riesz-bound (line 739): integral over D(z_0,r) of 1/|z-zeta| dA <= 2 pi r, with improvement r^2/|z_0| for zeta in D(0,|z_0|/4). Markov: at most ||p||_1/|z_0| critical points fail the improvement. Net: Psi <= (1/pi) * (2 pi n r^2 / |z_0| + 2 pi ||p||_1 r / |z_0|) = 2 (n r^2 / |z_0| + ||p||_1 r / |z_0|). K_Psi = 2 exactly.

step_by_step_extraction.step: Combine all X_i + Psi into Lemma sting bound
step_by_step_extraction.candidate_value: ell(dE_1 cap D(z_0,r)) <= K_sting * (n r^2 / |z_0| + r + r ||p||_1 / |z_0| + ||p||_1 log n / n)
step_by_step_extraction.notes: Sum of absolute constants: K_Psi=2 + K_X1<=20 pi + K_X2=pi + K_X3=2 pi + K_X5=2 pi + (X_4=0) = 2 + 20 pi + pi + 2 pi + 2 pi = 2 + 25 pi ~ 80.5. Add small buffer for cosec-asym leading 1 (the dyadic geometric series sum 1 + 1/4 + 1/16 + ... = 4/3 < 2 multiplies through) and for the implicit constant in 'covering D(zeta,r_1) by smaller disks if r_1 is large' from line 1511. Honest upper bound: K_sting <= 100. Tight upper bound (no buffer): K_sting <= 30. Both are NUMERIC -- no hidden Vinogradov, no Roth-style non-effective input, no dependence on c_10.

K_sting_verdict.construction: K_sting <= sum of absolute constants in Theorem stokes X_1..X_5 chain + Psi via multip. Honest UB: K_Psi(=2) + K_X1(<=20pi from pp-bound times area) + K_X2(=pi from area*lambda) + K_X3(<=2pi from multip + log-integral + markov) + K_X5(=2pi from arclength) = 2 + 25pi ~ 80.5, rounded up to 100 with buffer. Tight UB: 30 if K_pp Cauchy constant is 1 and cosec-asym/dyadic-series envelope is exactly 1.
K_sting_verdict.construction_complexity: All five X_i bounds are direct integrals against absolute Vinogradov constants (multip, markov, riesz-bound), all numeric and listed at Tao lines 242, 739, 743, 1397. No constituent depends on c_10, K_OR, or any non-effective input. Comparable to A3's K_OR extraction in cost.
K_sting_verdict.perplexity_oracle_consulted_reason: All cited Tao constants (markov, multip, riesz-bound, pp-bound, cosec-asym) verified directly in the TeX source at named line numbers; no external literature claim made. Hand-extraction sufficient.

N0_candidate_implications.verdict_rationale: Even at the impossibly tight K_sting = 1 floor (cannot occur since K_X5 alone is 2pi > 6), candidate N0 is ~ 10^25. The K_outside^4 = 10^12 multiplier dominates; the threshold remains 17+ orders of magnitude above the 10^8 middle-range bar and 13+ orders above the 10^12 INTRACTABLE_CONFIRMED bar. Refutation thresholds (N0 <= 10^4 or <= 10^8) are not approached under any plausible value of K_sting. The structural intractability of the middle range survives the extraction of K_sting.

asymmetry_observation.c_10_dependence: Candidate N0 scales as (1/c_10)^5; with c_10 >= 0.0069 (A2 rigorous bound), 1/c_10^5 ~ 6.45e10, which is the dominant universal numeric coefficient feeding 3.85e11. K_sting now numeric does NOT shift this scaling.
asymmetry_observation.implication: K_sting was not the bottleneck. The bottleneck is the c_10^{-5} amplification in Tao's a-ineq trade-off (line 1868). Even refining c_10 by a factor of 10 would only reduce N0 by 10^5, still leaving N0 > 10^20.

what_this_is_not: Not a fully verified numeric value of K_sting; the bound K_sting <= 100 is generous, K_sting <= 30 is tight but requires a tighter K_pp Cauchy analysis.
